description: Repo-scale (aspnet-helpdesk): POST /api/tickets/bulk-create must reject the whole batch if the CUMULATIVE ticket count would exceed the agent's maxOpenTickets - not check each ticket against a stale pre-batch baseline
prompts: Agents gain an optional `maxOpenTickets` field (a positive integer, or null/omitted meaning unlimited) - accept it in POST /api/agents and return it in agent responses. Add `POST /api/tickets/bulk-create`: body `{ agentId, tickets: [{ subject, priority }, ...] }`, creating every ticket assigned to that agent. It must be atomic: validate every ticket's subject/priority before creating anything. Critically, get the capacity check right: the invariant is that the agent's open-ticket count (status "open" or "in_progress") across existing tickets PLUS every ticket in this batch must never exceed maxOpenTickets. Compute the agent's current open count and compare it plus the batch size against maxOpenTickets ONCE for the whole batch - do not check each ticket individually against the pre-batch count, since that lets a batch of several tickets sail past a cap that would reject them if counted together. Reject the entire batch (nothing created) with 400 if it would overflow.
name: add_csharp_helpdesk_bulk_create_cumulative_capacity
